value: The second condition cannot be avoided: Joseph must live long enough to become corrupted, and then the visitor must defeat Redpath the Corrupted. Marduk’s role belongs to the Annals’ account; the quest objectives do not show every cause in the reenactment. The story keeps Joseph’s change distinct from Davil’s survival, so the battle’s altered course does not collapse into a claim that no one was lost or that the Scourge never reached Darrowshire.
editorNote: The replay’s objectives constrain what can change. Do not invent a lasting post-spell state beyond the quest account.
